(1) Behavioral, per resource: extend\n1536\t  apps/admin-api-service/src/billing/**tests**/billing.controller.spec.ts and add\n1537\t  apps/admin-api-service/src/audit/**tests**/audit.controller.spec.ts + a support ticket controller\n1538\t  spec, each booting the app with the SAME production ValidationPipe ({ whitelist:true,\n1539\t  forbidNonWhitelisted:true, transform:true }) and asserting the filtered GETs now return 200\n1540\t  (currently 400): GET /audit-logs?action=LOGIN&entityType=User&severity=HIGH&search=x; GET\n1541\t  /support/tickets?status=OPEN&priority=HIGH&search=x; GET\n1542\t  /billing/custom-plans?status=active&tier=pro&search=x. (1) Behavioral, per resource: extend\n  apps/admin-api-service/src/billing/**tests**/billing.controller.spec.ts and add\n  apps/admin-api-service/src/audit/**tests**/audit.controller.spec.ts + a support ticket controller\n  spec, each booting the app with the SAME production ValidationPipe ({ whitelist:true,\n  forbidNonWhitelisted:true, transform:true }) and asserting the filtered GETs now return 200\n  (currently 400): GET /audit-logs?action=LOGIN&entityType=User&severity=HIGH&search=x; GET\n  /support/tickets?status=OPEN&priority=HIGH&search=x; GET\n  /billing/custom-plans?status=active&tier=pro&search=x. PaginationQueryDto declares only\n1472\t  page/limit/sortBy/sortOrder. In NestJS an un-named @Query() binds the ENTIRE req.query and\n1473\t  validates it against its metatype (PaginationQueryDto); the co-located keyed\n1474\t  @Query('action'|'status'|'search'|...) values are present in that object but are non-whitelisted,\n1475\t  so forbidNonWhitelisted throws 400. The FE demonstrably serializes these filters onto the wire\n1476\t  (auditApi.query sends action/entityType/.../search; supportApi.getTickets sends\n1477\t  status/priority/category/assignedTo/tenantId/search; billing custom-plans sends\n1478\t  tenantId/status/tier/search via buildQueryString), so any filtered list 400s. No test catches it:\n1479\t  the billing controller spec (billing.controller.spec.ts:227) boots the identical production pipe\n1480\t  but only tests POST/PUT custom-plans, never GET /billing/custom-plans?status=..., and there is no\n1481\t  audit/ticket filtered-GET test at all. This is a systemic contract-drift CLASS (wire sends filters\n1482\t  the bound DTO does not declare), not a one-off. Two evidence nuances that do NOT change the\n1483\t  verdict: (a) NestJS version is v11 — behavior is unchanged; (b) three of the cited lines are\n1484\t  pure-pagination endpoints that bind only @Query() pagination with no keyed filter (ticket\n1485\t  getUnassignedTickets:201, billing getTenantRedemptions:433, getModulePricingHistory:468) and\n1486\t  therefore do NOT break — the genuinely-broken set is 7 handlers (audit queryAuditLogs; ticket\n1487\t  getAllTickets/getTicketsForTenant/getAssignedTickets/getComments/getReplies; billing\n1488\t  listCustomPlans). HIGH stands: the primary filtered-list usage of the audit trail (a SUPER_ADMIN\n1489\t  compliance/security surface), the support-ticket workflow, and custom-plan browsing all 400 on the\n1490\t  most common interaction, with zero regression coverage. Not CRITICAL — it is a clean 400 with no\n1491\t  data corruption or auth bypass, and the unfiltered base list still works.\n1492\t- **Root cause:** Contract drift at the FE->BE link: the frontend sends per-resource filter query\n1493\t  params, but the controllers bind those params two contradictory ways at once — individual filters\n1494\t  via keyed @Query('x') AND the whole query object via an un-named @Query() pagination?:\n1495\t  PaginationQueryDto. Because NestJS validates the un-named @Query() against its full metatype and\n1496\t  the platform pipe runs forbidNonWhitelisted:true, PaginationQueryDto (which knows only\n1497\t  page/limit/sortBy/sortOrder) becomes the de-facto allow-list for the ENTIRE query string, so every\n1498\t  declared filter is rejected as an unknown property. The type/validation contract (a\n1499\t  pagination-only DTO) never matched the wire contract (pagination + filters), and nothing forced\n1500\t  them to agree.\n1501\t- **Fix design:** Tier-1 (make the wrong shape impossible) at each callsite + Tier-3 (make the class\n1502\t  detectable) for the pattern. Local fix: for every filtered list endpoint, replace the split \"keyed\n1503\t  @Query('x') scalars + un-named @Query() PaginationQueryDto\" with a SINGLE per-resource query DTO\n1504\t  that `extends PaginationQueryDto` and declares every filter as a validated @IsOptional() property,\n1505\t  bound once as `@Query() query: XxxQueryDto`. Then the DTO's declared properties ARE the wire\n1506\t  contract exactly: whitelist strips nothing legitimate and forbidNonWhitelisted only rejects\n1507\t  genuinely-unknown keys, and it is structurally impossible for a filter to be absent from the\n1508\t  validated DTO because there is exactly one binding and it is the DTO. { TenantParam } from '@aquaculture/backend-common/decorators';\nimport { Controller, Get, Query, Param, ParseUUIDPipe } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';\nimport { PaginationQueryDto } from '../shared/pagination-query.dto';\nimport { clampLimit } from '../shared/sort-field.util';\n\nimport { AuditLog, AuditSeverity } from './audit.entity';\nimport { AuditLogService, AuditLogFilter } from './audit.service';\n\n@ApiTags('Security')\n@Controller('audit-logs')\nexport class AuditLogController {\n  constructor(private readonly auditLogService: AuditLogService) {}\n\n  /**\n   * ADMIN-MEDIUM-003: Write a meta-audit entry when audit logs are read.\n   * An admin reading sensitive audit entries must leave a trace. Without\n   * this, an insider could read audit data without detection.\n   */\n  private async writeMetaAudit(action: string, details: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<void> {\n    // Awaited and fail-closed (ADMIN-CRITICAL-102): an audit read whose own\n    // trace cannot be written does not return the data. The actor is the\n    // guard-verified principal in the request frame, never a caller string.\n    await this.auditLogService.record({\n      action: 'AUDIT_LOG_ACCESSED',\n      entityType: 'AuditLog',\n      details: { subAction: action, ...details },\n    });\n  }\n\n  @Get()\n  async queryAuditLogs(\n    @Query('action') action?: string,\n    @Query('entityType') entityType?: string,\n    @Query('entityId') entityId?: string,\n    @TenantParam('query', { optional: true }) tenantId?: string,\n    @Query('performedBy') performedBy?: string,\n    @Query('severity') severity?: AuditSeverity,\n    @Query('startDate') startDate?: string,\n    @Query('endDate') endDate?: string,\n    @Query('search') search?: string,\n    @Query() pagination?: PaginationQueryDto,\n  ) {\n    const filter: AuditLogFilter = {\n      action,\n      entityType,\n      entityId,\n      tenantId,\n      performedBy,\n      severity,\n      startDate: startDate ? new Date(startDate) : undefined,\n      endDate: endDate ? new Date(endDate) : undefined,\n      search,\n    };\n\n    // ADMIN-MEDIUM-003: meta-audit -- record that audit logs were queried\n    await this.writeMetaAudit('QUERY', { filter: { action, entityType, tenantId, severity } });\n\n    return this.auditLogService.query(filter, pagination?.page ?? 1, pagination?.limit ?? 50);\n  }\n\n  @Get('entity/:entityType/:entityId')\n  async getEntityHistory(\n    @Param('entityType') entityType: string,\n    @Param('entityId', ParseUUIDPipe) entityId: string,\n    @Query('limit') limit?: string,\n  ): Promise<AuditLog[]> {\n    // ADMIN-MEDIUM-003: meta-audit\n    await this.writeMetaAudit('ENTITY_HISTORY', { entityType, entityId });\n    // SEC-MEDIUM №17 (2026-08-23 scan): clamp before .take()\n    return this.auditLogService.getEntityHistory(entityType, entityId, clampLimit(limit, 100));\n  }\n\n  @Get('user/:userId')\n  async getUserActivity(\n    @Param('userId') userId: string,\n    @Query('startDate') startDate?: string,\n    @Query('endDate') endDate?: string,\n    @Query('limit') limit?: string,\n  ): Promise<AuditLog[]> {","numLines":80,"startLine":1,"totalLines":116}}}
